purpose: Source-only diagnostic checklist before this article acquisition; temporal claims and reported counts kept separately, no answer labels consulted.

source.title: Taylor Swift-Travis Kelce timeline: Everything to know about rumored romance between pop star, Chiefs TE
source.author: Shanna McCarriston

assertions.subject: report overview
assertions.assertion: Swift reportedly attended five Chiefs games this season including Chargers game; keep reported count even if timeline enumerates fewer distinct games

negative_checks: Lyrics are editorial decoration; do not turn them into events or reproduce them in the checklist.
Do not invent omitted August 5 answer, restaurant/camp name, missing fifth game, or unnamed-source identity.
Distinguish reported first meeting times, speculation, invitation, attendance and anonymous commentary.
Keep separate stock/date-free game metrics, follower gains, jersey sales, ticket platform and comparisons; broader NFL-sales claim in another source is not the same population as Kelce jersey sales.
